words.enDefinition: The conditions for recording an item in the financial statements under the relevant accounting framework.

examples.en: The class checked the recognition criteria before deciding whether to include the equipment in the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 全班先核对「确认条件」，再决定是否把设备列入资产负债表。

examples.en: We read the FASB framework's recognition criteria before checking whether the amount could be measured faithfully.
examples.zh: 我们先读了 FASB 概念框架的「确认条件」，再核查金额能否得到如实计量。

collocations: review the recognition criteria for an asset

words.enDefinition: The first inclusion of an item as an element of the financial statements.

examples.en: In our example, initial recognition took place when the company obtained control of the printing equipment.
examples.zh: 例题中，公司取得印刷设备的控制权时进行了「初始确认」。

examples.en: The timeline showed initial recognition of the liability before the company made its first payment.
examples.zh: 时间线显示，公司在第一次付款前就对该负债进行了「初始确认」。

collocations: record an item on initial recognition

words.enDefinition: Determining the amount assigned to an item when it is first recognised.

examples.en: The worksheet used the purchase price and installation costs for initial measurement of the new printer.
examples.zh: 练习表用购买价和安装费对新打印机进行「初始计量」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which costs formed part of the initial measurement of the machine in the case.
examples.zh: 老师问，例题中哪些成本计入机器的「初始计量」金额。

collocations: apply a rule for initial measurement

words.enDefinition: Determining the reported amount of an item after its initial recognition.

examples.en: The exercise separated the purchase entry from subsequent measurement after the company began using the machine.
examples.zh: 设备投入使用后，练习把购入分录与「后续计量」分开处理。

examples.en: We compared two policies for subsequent measurement of the same equipment across the three sample reports.
examples.zh: 我们对比了三份示例报告对同一设备采用的两种「后续计量」政策。

collocations: review the requirements for subsequent measurement
select a model for subsequent measurement

words.enDefinition: The specified feature used to determine a reported amount, such as historical cost or fair value.

examples.en: The accounting policy note identified the measurement basis for each category of equipment in the report.
examples.zh: 报告的会计政策附注列明了各类设备所用的「计量基础」。

examples.en: We highlighted the measurement basis before comparing amounts for the same type of property across companies.
examples.zh: 比较各公司同类物业的账面金额之前，我们先标出了「计量基础」。

words.enDefinition: Determining a revised amount for an item that has already been recognised.

examples.en: The change in exchange rates led to remeasurement of the foreign currency payable in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 汇率变动后，我们在练习表里对外币应付款进行了「重新计量」。

examples.en: Our example showed a gain on remeasurement after the revised estimate reduced the amount of the liability.
examples.zh: 例题中，修订后的估计使负债金额减少，因「重新计量」而产生了利得。

words.enDefinition: Removal of all or part of a previously recognised asset or liability from the statement of financial position.

examples.en: The accountant recorded derecognition of the laboratory equipment after the buyer took control in the example.
examples.zh: 例题中，买方取得实验设备的控制权后，会计办理了「终止确认」。

examples.en: Our worksheet linked derecognition of the payable to the discharge of the company's contractual obligation.
examples.zh: 练习表把应付款的「终止确认」与公司合同义务的解除联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Removal of a qualifying part of a recognised asset or liability while the remaining part stays recorded.

examples.en: In the case, partial derecognition removed the repaid portion of the debt while the balance remained payable.
examples.zh: 例题中，债务已偿还的部分作「部分终止确认」，余额仍然应付。

examples.en: The tutor used partial derecognition to explain why the retained portion was still on the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 老师用「部分终止确认」说明为什么保留的部分仍在资产负债表上。

collocations: calculate a gain on partial derecognition

words.enDefinition: Uncertainty that arises when a reported amount cannot be observed directly and must be estimated.

examples.en: The estimates note explained the measurement uncertainty around the future cost of restoring the leased site.
examples.zh: 估计事项附注解释了租用场地未来恢复成本的「计量不确定性」。

examples.en: The class discussed measurement uncertainty because available prices could not directly establish the equipment's fair value.
examples.zh: 现有价格无法直接确定设备的公允价值，大家因此讨论了「计量不确定性」。

collocations: a high degree of measurement uncertainty

words.enDefinition: Uncertainty about whether an asset or liability exists at all.

examples.en: The dispute created existence uncertainty because the class could not tell whether the company had an obligation.
examples.zh: 这场争议产生了「存在不确定性」，因为同学们无法判断公司是否负有义务。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed existence uncertainty before anyone tried to estimate the amount of the disputed liability.
examples.zh: 任何人着手估计争议负债的金额之前，老师先讲了「存在不确定性」。

collocations: explain the source of existence uncertainty

words.enDefinition: Uncertainty about the amount or timing of future inflows or outflows arising from an asset or liability.

examples.en: There was outcome uncertainty because the repair obligation existed but the timing of payments was unclear.
examples.zh: 维修义务已经存在，但付款时间不清楚，因此有「结果不确定性」。

examples.en: Our report described outcome uncertainty for the receivables even though we knew the customers owed the money.
examples.zh: 虽然我们知道顾客确实欠款，报告仍说明了这些应收款的「结果不确定性」。

words.enDefinition: a right, obligation, or group of rights and obligations to which accounting recognition or measurement concepts are applied

examples.en: The workshop example used each machine as its unit of account when discussing recognition and measurement.
examples.zh: 工场例题讨论确认和计量时，把每台机器视作一个「会计处理单元」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the package of rights should be treated as one unit of account.
examples.zh: 老师问，这一组权利是否应当作为一个「会计处理单元」。

collocations: determine the appropriate unit of account
apply a measurement basis to the unit of account

words.enDefinition: Measurement using updated conditions at the measurement date, such as fair value or value in use.

examples.en: The lecturer used current value measurement to explain why later market conditions affected the reported amount.
examples.zh: 老师用「现时价值计量」解释为什么之后的市场状况会影响列报金额。

examples.en: Our exercise contrasted current value measurement with keeping an asset at an amount based on original cost.
examples.zh: 练习把「现时价值计量」与按原始成本计量资产的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: In the IFRS impairment model, the present value of cash flows expected from using and ultimately disposing of an asset or unit.

examples.en: In the impairment case, we estimated value in use for equipment that the company planned to keep operating.
examples.zh: 在减值例题中，我们估算了公司打算继续使用的设备的「使用价值」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how cash expected at disposal was included in the calculation of value in use.
examples.zh: 老师解释了计算「使用价值」时怎样计入处置资产预计收到的现金。

collocations: compare value in use with carrying amount

words.enDefinition: The present value of resources an entity expects to transfer as it fulfils a liability.

examples.en: Our tutor used fulfilment value to discuss what the entity expected to spend on meeting its obligations.
examples.zh: 老师用「履约价值」来讨论主体预计为履行义务付出多少资源。

examples.en: The exercise asked how a longer schedule of expected payments would affect the obligation's fulfilment value.
examples.zh: 练习问，预计的付款时间拉长会怎样影响这项义务的「履约价值」。

collocations: calculate the fulfilment value of a liability
compare fulfilment value with fair value

words.enDefinition: An amount used instead of cost or depreciated cost on a specified date under a transition rule.

examples.en: The IFRS transition exercise used the building's fair value as deemed cost on the transition date.
examples.zh: 在首次采用国际财务报告准则的例题中，建筑物转换日的公允价值用作「认定成本」。

examples.en: Our example calculated later depreciation using the deemed cost established when the company first adopted IFRS.
examples.zh: 例题以公司首次采用国际财务报告准则时确定的「认定成本」计算之后的折旧。

collocations: use fair value as deemed cost

words.enDefinition: The price received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in a market transaction.

examples.en: The example's exit price was the amount market participants would pay to buy the equipment.
examples.zh: 例题中的「退出价格」是市场参与者为买入这台设备愿意支付的金额。

examples.en: We compared the exit price with the amount originally paid for the instrument in the case.
examples.zh: 例题中，我们把该工具的「退出价格」与最初的购买价作了比较。

collocations: an exit price for an asset
measure fair value using an exit price

words.enDefinition: The price paid to acquire an asset or received to take on a liability in a transaction.

examples.en: The entry price for the equipment was the amount the company paid in the example transaction.
examples.zh: 设备的「进入价格」是例题中公司为购入该设备所支付的金额。

examples.en: Our group asked why the entry price might differ from the price available on immediate resale.
examples.zh: 我们组问，「进入价格」为什么可能与立即转售可获得的价格不同。

collocations: the entry price of an asset
compare entry price with exit price

words.enDefinition: Assumptions independent, informed market participants would apply when pricing an asset or liability.

examples.en: The valuation used market participant assumptions about rental income rather than the owner's own business plans.
examples.zh: 估值采用了关于租金的「市场参与者假设」，未将所有者自己的经营计划作为依据。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the market participant assumptions in the practice valuation were supported by evidence.
examples.zh: 老师问，练习估值中的「市场参与者假设」有没有证据支持。

collocations: a model based on market participant assumptions

words.enDefinition: In fair value measurement, the accessible market with the greatest volume and activity for the item.

examples.en: We identified the principal market by checking which accessible marketplace had the highest trading activity for the asset.
examples.zh: 我们核查哪个可进入的市场对该资产的交易最活跃，以确定「主要市场」。

examples.en: The fair value example used the principal market even though another accessible market offered a better price.
examples.zh: 公允价值例题采用「主要市场」，尽管另一个可进入的市场报价更有利。

collocations: observe prices in the principal market
lack access to the principal market

words.enDefinition: The accessible market with the best net proceeds or lowest net transfer cost after transaction and transport costs.

examples.en: With no principal market identified, we compared accessible exchanges to find the most advantageous market.
examples.zh: 未找到主要市场时，我们对比了可进入的交易场所，以确定「最有利市场」。

examples.en: Our tutor deducted selling and transport costs when comparing the alternatives for the most advantageous market.
examples.zh: 老师比较各个候选市场时扣除了销售及运输成本，以确定「最有利市场」。

collocations: use the most advantageous market when no principal market exists

words.enDefinition: A market transaction allowing usual exposure and marketing, without a forced sale or distress liquidation.

examples.en: The valuation exercise treated the sale as an orderly transaction because the equipment had been marketed normally.
examples.zh: 估值练习将这笔出售视为「有序交易」，因为设备已经过正常的市场推介。

examples.en: Our tutor questioned whether an immediate forced sale could provide the price of an orderly transaction.
examples.zh: 老师问，迫于压力立即出售的价格能否代表「有序交易」的价格。

words.enDefinition: A method of estimating an asset or liability value from market, cost, or income information.

examples.en: The notes described the valuation technique before listing the assumptions used to estimate the property value.
examples.zh: 附注先讲了「估值技术」，接着列出估算物业价值所用的假设。

examples.en: The class compared a valuation technique based on recent sales with one using expected rental income.
examples.zh: 全班对比了两种「估值技术」，分别依据近期售价与预计租金收入。

words.enDefinition: Valuation variables developed from market data that reflect assumptions used by market participants.

examples.en: We used observable inputs from recent comparable sales to estimate the value of the practice building.
examples.zh: 我们用近期可比交易中的「可观察输入值」估算例题建筑物的价值。

examples.en: The note identified observable inputs from public markets even though the asset itself was not traded there.
examples.zh: 虽然该资产本身未在公开市场交易，附注仍列出了源自公开市场的「可观察输入值」。

collocations: give priority to relevant observable inputs

words.enDefinition: Market data or assumptions entered into a technique to estimate an asset or liability value.

examples.en: We checked the valuation inputs before comparing the two reports on the same office building.
examples.zh: 我们在比较同一办公楼的两份报告之前，先核查了「估值输入值」。

examples.en: The note explained which valuation inputs came from market transactions and which relied on other evidence.
examples.zh: 附注说明哪些「估值输入值」来自市场交易，哪些依据其他证据。

words.enDefinition: The three-level classification of a fair value measurement based on its lowest significant level of input.

examples.en: The fair value hierarchy helped us classify the measurements according to the significant inputs each model used.
examples.zh: 我们用「公允价值层次」根据各模型所用的重要输入值对计量结果分类。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where a measurement with significant unobservable assumptions belonged within the fair value hierarchy.
examples.zh: 老师问，一项含重要不可观察假设的计量在「公允价值层次」中属于哪一层。

collocations: classify a measurement in the fair value hierarchy
the levels of the fair value hierarchy

words.enDefinition: Unadjusted quoted prices in accessible active markets for identical assets or liabilities at the measurement date.

examples.en: The report used level 1 inputs for shares with current quoted prices in an accessible active market.
examples.zh: 报告对在可进入的活跃市场有当前报价的股票采用「第一层次输入值」。

examples.en: The exercise excluded adjusted quotes for similar items from the list of level 1 inputs.
examples.zh: 练习列举「第一层次输入值」时，没有纳入类似项目经调整的报价。

words.enDefinition: Observable inputs other than Level 1 quoted prices, obtained directly or indirectly for an asset or liability.

examples.en: The valuation used level 2 inputs from observable yield curves for the remaining term of the instrument.
examples.zh: 估值采用可观察收益率曲线中对应工具剩余期限的「第二层次输入值」。

examples.en: The case treated quoted prices for similar assets in active markets as level 2 inputs.
examples.zh: 例题将类似资产在活跃市场的报价列作「第二层次输入值」。

collocations: observable yield curves as level 2 inputs

words.enDefinition: Unobservable variables used to measure fair value when relevant observable market inputs are unavailable.

examples.en: The valuation used level 3 inputs for rental growth because relevant market data was unavailable.
examples.zh: 缺少相关市场数据，因此这项估值对租金增长采用了「第三层次输入值」。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the note explained the level 3 inputs used to value the property.
examples.zh: 老师问，附注怎样解释物业估值采用的「第三层次输入值」。

collocations: estimate fair value with level 3 inputs

words.enDefinition: A fair value measurement required or permitted in the statement of financial position at each reporting period end.

examples.en: The exercise showed a recurring fair value measurement for property remeasured at the end of each year.
examples.zh: 例题中的物业每年末都重新计量，体现了「经常性公允价值计量」。

examples.en: The table identified the hierarchy level for each recurring fair value measurement shown in the sample statements.
examples.zh: 表格标明了示例报表中每项「经常性公允价值计量」所属的层次。

collocations: identify a recurring fair value measurement
disclose a recurring fair value measurement
classify a recurring fair value measurement within the hierarchy

words.enDefinition: Changes in fair value hierarchy classification between reporting dates, such as after observable market inputs become unavailable.
acceptedEnVariants: transfers between levels of the fair value hierarchy

examples.en: The note explained transfers between hierarchy levels after new market data became available for some instruments.
examples.zh: 部分金融工具有了新的市场数据后，附注说明了对应的「公允价值层次间转移」。

examples.en: Our group matched the reported transfers between hierarchy levels to the changes described in the valuation note.
examples.zh: 我们组把列报的「公允价值层次间转移」和估值附注中说明的变化对应起来。

collocations: report the timing of transfers between hierarchy levels

words.enDefinition: A rollforward explaining changes between opening and closing balances for recurring Level 3 fair value measurements.

examples.en: The level 3 reconciliation showed a gain as well as assets sold during the reporting period.
examples.zh: 「第三层次余额调节表」同时列示了一笔利得和报告期内售出的资产。

examples.en: We used the level 3 reconciliation to trace how the closing fair value differed from the opening balance.
examples.zh: 我们用「第三层次余额调节表」追踪期末公允价值与期初余额为何不同。

collocations: show transfers in a level 3 reconciliation

words.enDefinition: A description or quantification of how changes in valuation assumptions could change the reported fair value.

examples.en: The fair value sensitivity disclosure explained how a different rent assumption might alter the estimate for the property.
examples.zh: 「公允价值敏感性披露」解释了不同租金假设可能怎样影响物业的估值。

examples.en: Our group compared the fair value sensitivity disclosure with the assumptions listed in the preceding table.
examples.zh: 我们组把「公允价值敏感性披露」与前表所列的假设对照了一下。

collocations: prepare a fair value sensitivity disclosure
review a fair value sensitivity disclosure
describe an input in a fair value sensitivity disclosure

words.enDefinition: the physically possible, legally permissible and financially feasible use of a nonfinancial asset that maximises its value to market participants

examples.en: The valuation exercise considered whether the site's current use was also its highest and best use.
examples.zh: 估值练习考虑了该地块目前的用途是否也是它的「最高最佳用途」。

examples.en: In class, we considered legal restrictions and physical access when discussing the land's highest and best use.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论该地块的「最高最佳用途」时考虑了法律限制和实际通达条件。

collocations: determine the highest and best use
assess the highest and best use of land
value property at its highest and best use

words.enDefinition: Changing a principle, basis or practice used to prepare and present financial statements.

examples.en: The sample report explained a change in accounting policy for measuring a class of investment properties.
examples.zh: 示例报告说明了某类投资性房地产计量所涉及的「会计政策变更」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which figures could be affected by the change in accounting policy described in the notes.
examples.zh: 老师问，附注所述的「会计政策变更」可能影响哪些数据。

collocations: explain a change in accounting policy
apply a change in accounting policy retrospectively
disclose the effect of a change in accounting policy

words.enDefinition: A revision to an estimated amount made after new information, developments or experience becomes available.

examples.en: Inspection of the equipment led to a change in accounting estimate for its remaining useful life.
examples.zh: 检查设备后，企业对剩余使用寿命作了「会计估计变更」。

examples.en: The class identified a change in accounting estimate when the latest repair data altered expected warranty costs.
examples.zh: 最新维修数据改变了预计保修成本，同学们据此识别出一项「会计估计变更」。

collocations: account for a change in accounting estimate
explain a change in accounting estimate
disclose a material change in accounting estimate

words.enDefinition: Applying a new accounting policy to past transactions and events as if it had always been used.

examples.en: In the case, retrospective application meant using the new policy for transactions in the comparative year.
examples.zh: 在例题中，「追溯应用」指把新政策用到比较年度的交易上。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how retrospective application of the new policy affected the earliest opening equity balance.
examples.zh: 老师演示了新政策的「追溯应用」如何影响最早列报期的期初权益余额。

collocations: explain retrospective application of a policy

words.enDefinition: Correcting prior-period financial information as if the error had never occurred.

examples.en: The retrospective restatement corrected the comparative figures after we found a material error in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习表里发现重大差错后，我们用「追溯重述」更正了比较数据。

examples.en: Our tutor used retrospective restatement to illustrate how a misclassified expense affected the previous year's figures.
examples.zh: 老师用「追溯重述」说明误分类的费用怎样影响上一年的数据。

collocations: explain the effect of retrospective restatement
require retrospective restatement of comparative figures

words.enDefinition: Applying a changed policy from the change date or recognising an estimate change in affected current and later periods.

examples.en: The class used prospective application for the new useful life estimate after reviewing the machine's condition.
examples.zh: 看过机器状态后，同学们对新的使用寿命估计采用「未来适用法」。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed prospective application by revising depreciation from the estimate change date and leaving earlier figures unchanged.
examples.zh: 练习表演示了「未来适用法」，从估计变更之日起调整折旧，保留之前期间的数字。

collocations: contrast prospective application with retrospective application
explain prospective application of an estimate change

words.enDefinition: A change to balances at the start of a presented period, such as for a retrospective correction.

examples.en: The notes explained an adjustment to opening balances because the error predated both of the years presented.
examples.zh: 差错发生在列报的两个年度之前，附注因此解释了一项「期初余额调整」。

examples.en: We located the adjustment to opening balances in the equity statement before checking the accounting policy note.
examples.zh: 我们先在权益变动表找到「期初余额调整」，再检查会计政策附注。

collocations: record an adjustment to opening balances
explain an adjustment to opening balances
show the adjustment to opening balances in equity

words.enDefinition: An exception available when a requirement cannot be applied despite every reasonable effort to do so.

examples.en: The class discussed the impracticability exception because the surviving records could not support reconstructing the comparative figures.
examples.zh: 留存记录无法支持重新编制比较数据，因此全班讨论了「不可行例外」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what efforts the case entity had made before using the impracticability exception.
examples.zh: 老师问，例题里的主体在采用「不可行例外」前作了哪些努力。

words.expression: cumulative effect of a policy change
words.lemma: cumulative effect of a policy change
words.enDefinition: The combined effect that applying a changed accounting policy would have on balances up to a specified date.
acceptedEnVariants: cumulative effect of a policy change

examples.en: We calculated the cumulative effect of a policy change before comparing the new and old opening balances.
examples.zh: 我们先计算「政策变更的累积影响」，再比较新旧期初余额。

examples.en: The note reported the cumulative effect of a policy change separately from the effect on current expenses.
examples.zh: 附注把「政策变更的累积影响」与对当期费用的影响分开列报。

collocations: calculate the cumulative effect of a policy change
describe the cumulative effect of a policy change
adjust equity for the cumulative effect of a policy change

words.enDefinition: Rules within a new standard explaining how to move from the previous accounting requirements to the new ones.

examples.en: We read the transition provisions before deciding which comparative figures the classroom company would present.
examples.zh: 我们先看「过渡规定」，再判断课堂例题中的公司该列报哪些比较数据。

examples.en: The footnote described the transition provisions the group had followed when it first applied the standard.
examples.zh: 脚注说明了集团首次应用该准则时遵循的「过渡规定」。

collocations: disclose an election under transition provisions

words.enDefinition: Applying a standard or amendment before its mandatory effective date when that is permitted.

examples.en: The standard permitted early application, and the classroom company used it a year before it became mandatory.
examples.zh: 这项准则允许「提前应用准则」，课堂例题里的公司在强制生效前一年就采用了。

examples.en: Our group noted early application before comparing the sample financial statements with those of a similar entity.
examples.zh: 我们组先记下「提前应用准则」的情况，再将示例财报与同类主体的财报作比较。

collocations: disclose early application of a standard

words.enDefinition: The date from which an entity first applies a standard or amendment under the relevant transition requirements.

examples.en: The note identified the date of initial application and explained which balances changed at that point.
examples.zh: 附注指明了「首次应用日」，并解释哪些余额在当天发生变化。

examples.en: We marked the date of initial application before working through the transition example in class.
examples.zh: 我们标出「首次应用日」，才开始做课堂上的过渡例题。

collocations: identify the date of initial application
adjust balances at the date of initial application
the date of initial application of a standard

words.enDefinition: Issued standards that are not mandatory for the entity's current reporting period.

examples.en: The sample note on new standards not yet effective described what the company expected to change next year.
examples.zh: 示例里的「尚未生效的新准则」附注说明了公司预计下一年在哪些方面发生变化。

examples.en: The class looked for new standards not yet effective in the first section of the accounting policies note.
examples.zh: 同学们在会计政策附注的第一节查找「尚未生效的新准则」。

collocations: identify new standards not yet effective
a note on new standards not yet effective
assess the impact of new standards not yet effective

words.enDefinition: Information about accounting policies that can influence decisions by primary users when read with the other financial information.

examples.en: The revised note kept material accounting policy information about customer rebates and removed generic descriptions of unrelated policies.
examples.zh: 修订后的附注保留了顾客返利的「重大会计政策信息」，删去了无关政策的通用说明。

examples.en: Our class looked for material accounting policy information that helped readers understand the reported amounts.
examples.zh: 全班查找了有助于读者理解列报金额的「重大会计政策信息」。

collocations: decide what constitutes material accounting policy information

words.enDefinition: Information explaining how an entity applies an accounting policy in its own circumstances.

examples.en: The note gave entity-specific policy information by explaining how the company accounted for refunds on annual memberships.
examples.zh: 这份附注说明了公司如何核算年度会籍的退款，提供了「主体特有的政策信息」。

examples.en: The tutor asked for entity-specific policy information about the sample company's unusual delivery arrangements.
examples.zh: 老师要求就示例公司不同寻常的交付安排提供「主体特有的政策信息」。

collocations: replace boilerplate with entity-specific policy information

words.enDefinition: Notes explaining decisions in applying accounting policies that have the most significant effects on recognised amounts, apart from estimates.

examples.en: The significant judgement disclosures explained why the group concluded that it controlled the smaller company.
examples.zh: 「重大判断披露」解释了集团为什么认定自己控制了那家较小的公司。

examples.en: We used the significant judgement disclosures to understand how the sample report classified the supplier arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们用「重大判断披露」了解示例报告怎样对供应商安排进行分类。

collocations: read significant judgement disclosures alongside accounting policies

words.enDefinition: Assumptions and conditions that make amounts in financial statements uncertain and can lead to later revisions.

examples.en: The property note discussed sources of estimation uncertainty such as future occupancy and expected rental income.
examples.zh: 物业附注讨论了未来出租率、预计租金收入等「估计不确定性的来源」。

examples.en: Our group located the sources of estimation uncertainty before trying to interpret the figures in the example.
examples.zh: 我们组先找出「估计不确定性的来源」，再试着读懂例题里的数字。

collocations: disclose major sources of estimation uncertainty

words.enDefinition: the risk that estimation uncertainty will cause a significant change to the carrying amount of an asset or liability

examples.en: The notes identified a risk of material adjustment to the carrying amount of the warehouse next year.
examples.zh: 附注指出，仓库账面金额下一年存在「重大调整风险」。

examples.en: The class discussed the risk of material adjustment when estimates depended heavily on one market assumption.
examples.zh: 估计很大程度上依赖一个市场假设，大家因此讨论了「重大调整风险」。

collocations: a significant risk of material adjustment
explain a risk of material adjustment
assess the risk of material adjustment to carrying amounts

words.zhGloss: 对假设变化的敏感程度
words.enDefinition: How much an estimate or reported amount could change if its underlying assumptions change.
acceptedZhAnswers: 对假设变化的敏感程度

examples.en: The note showed sensitivity to assumptions about how many buyers would claim rebates after the promotion.
examples.zh: 附注展示了估计金额「对假设变化的敏感程度」，这里的假设涉及促销后有多少买家会申请返利。

examples.en: Our tutor compared sensitivity to assumptions across two estimates using the same hypothetical change in demand.
examples.zh: 老师假设需求变化相同，比较了两项估计「对假设变化的敏感程度」。

collocations: show an estimate's sensitivity to assumptions

words.enDefinition: The expected impact of a current event or accounting change on amounts reported in later periods.

examples.en: The depreciation note estimated the effect on future periods of giving the equipment a longer useful life.
examples.zh: 折旧附注估算了延长设备使用寿命「对以后期间的影响」。

examples.en: Our group distinguished the effect on future periods from the amount recorded in the current year.
examples.zh: 我们把「对以后期间的影响」与本年入账的金额分开来看。

collocations: estimate the effect on future periods
disclose the expected effect on future periods
describe the effect on future periods

words.enDefinition: The date as of which the end-of-period financial position is presented.

examples.en: The tutor asked what information about the damaged inventory was available at the reporting date.
examples.zh: 老师问，截至「报告期末日」可以获得哪些有关受损存货的信息。

examples.en: We marked the reporting date on the timeline before adding the later events discussed in the case.
examples.zh: 我们先在时间线上标出「报告期末日」，再加入例题讨论的后续事项。

words.enDefinition: Events occurring after the reporting period ends and before the financial statements are authorised for issue.

examples.en: The lecturer used a timeline to show which developments counted as events after the reporting period.
examples.zh: 老师用一条时间线说明哪些情况算「资产负债表日后事项」。

examples.en: The note on events after the reporting period described a fire that occurred before the statements were authorised.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表日后事项」附注说明了报表获准报出前发生的一场火灾。

collocations: review events after the reporting period
disclose material events after the reporting period
classify events after the reporting period

words.enDefinition: An event after the period providing evidence of a condition that already existed at the reporting date.

examples.en: The case treated the court decision as an adjusting event because the underlying dispute existed at year end.
examples.zh: 例题把法院判决作为「日后调整事项」，因为相关争议在年末已经存在。

examples.en: The later inventory sale was an adjusting event because it confirmed the condition of inventory at year end.
examples.zh: 后续存货销售印证了年末存货的状况，因此属于「日后调整事项」。

collocations: recognise the effect of an adjusting event
treat later evidence as an adjusting event

words.enDefinition: An event after the period indicating a condition arising after the reporting date.

examples.en: The exercise classified a fire occurring after year end as a non-adjusting event and explained its impact.
examples.zh: 练习把年末后发生的火灾列为「日后非调整事项」，并说明其影响。

examples.en: The tutor asked which note should describe the non-adjusting event and its estimated financial effect.
examples.zh: 老师问，哪个附注应说明这项「日后非调整事项」和它预计的财务影响。

collocations: describe the nature of a non-adjusting event

words.enDefinition: Formally approved for release by the body responsible for giving that approval.

examples.en: The sample financial statements were authorised for issue two weeks before they were published on the website.
examples.zh: 示例财务报表在网站公开前两周已「获准报出」。

examples.en: The note named the body that approved the financial statements and said when they were authorised for issue.
examples.zh: 附注写明了批准财务报表的机构，以及报表何时「获准报出」。

collocations: the date the accounts were authorised for issue
before the statements were authorised for issue

words.enDefinition: An approximation of how much a disclosed event or change may affect the financial statements.

examples.en: The note gave an estimate of the financial effect of the warehouse damage that occurred in January.
examples.zh: 附注就一月发生的仓库损坏给出了「财务影响估计」。

examples.en: An estimate of the financial effect was unavailable because the engineers had yet to assess the building.
examples.zh: 工程师尚未评估建筑物，因此暂时无法提供「财务影响估计」。

collocations: provide an estimate of the financial effect
prepare an estimate of the financial effect
explain why an estimate of the financial effect is unavailable

words.enDefinition: The financial statement note describing relevant events occurring after the reporting period.

examples.en: The subsequent events note described an acquisition agreed after the end of the financial year.
examples.zh: 「日后事项附注」介绍了财务年度结束后达成的一项收购。

examples.en: We checked the subsequent events note before drawing conclusions about the company's position at year end.
examples.zh: 在对公司年末财务状况作出判断前，我们查看了「日后事项附注」。

collocations: include information in the subsequent events note

words.enDefinition: Choosing the accounting principles or methods used for a transaction under the applicable reporting framework.

examples.en: The case focused on accounting policy selection for a transaction that no standard addressed directly.
examples.zh: 例题重点讨论在没有准则直接适用时，如何对一项交易作「会计政策选择」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how accounting policy selection could affect comparability between companies that hold similar assets.
examples.zh: 老师问，「会计政策选择」会怎样影响持有相似资产的公司之间的可比性。

collocations: review the basis for accounting policy selection

words.enDefinition: Under the SEC's MD&A rules, estimates with significant uncertainty and a material actual or reasonably likely impact.

examples.en: The US filing discussed critical accounting estimates in management's discussion and analysis alongside the business results.
examples.zh: 这份美国申报文件在管理层讨论与分析中一并讨论了经营结果和「关键会计估计」。

examples.en: In class, we compared critical accounting estimates in the US filing with the measurement policies in its notes.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们对照了美国申报文件的「关键会计估计」和附注中的计量政策。

collocations: explain uncertainty in critical accounting estimates

words.enDefinition: Financial information representing the substance of a transaction or condition completely, neutrally and without error in its description.

examples.en: The class discussed faithful representation after the report described a lease solely by its contract title.
examples.zh: 报告只依据合同名称描述了一项租赁，之后全班讨论了「如实反映」的问题。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how explaining the estimate's uncertainty could improve faithful representation in the example.
examples.zh: 老师问，在例题中解释估计的不确定性，怎样有助于实现「如实反映」。

collocations: a faithful representation of the transaction

words.enDefinition: Data and assumptions used in a measurement method to develop an estimated financial amount.

examples.en: The class checked accounting estimate inputs before deciding whether the expected repair costs had genuinely changed.
examples.zh: 大家先核查了「会计估计输入值」，再判断预计维修成本是否真的变了。

examples.en: The note showed that new customer data changed accounting estimate inputs while the measurement technique stayed the same.
examples.zh: 附注说明，新的客户数据改变了「会计估计输入值」，计量技术没有变化。

collocations: explain changes in accounting estimate inputs

words.enDefinition: A statement of financial position as of the beginning of a period, presented in specified circumstances.

examples.en: The first-time IFRS exercise began with an opening statement of financial position at the date of transition.
examples.zh: 首次采用国际财务报告准则的练习先编制了转换日的「期初财务状况表」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the restatement example included an opening statement of financial position for the comparative period.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么重述例题包含比较期间开始日的「期初财务状况表」。

collocations: prepare an opening statement of financial position
an opening statement of financial position at transition
present an opening statement of financial position

words.enDefinition: An existing duty resulting from past events that the entity has no practical ability to avoid.

examples.en: The example identified a present obligation because the goods had already been sold with a repair guarantee.
examples.zh: 由于商品已经售出并附有维修保证，例题认定存在一项「现时义务」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what evidence showed that the company had a present obligation at year end.
examples.zh: 老师问，有什么证据表明该公司年末已存在「现时义务」。

collocations: assess whether a present obligation exists

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, a past event creating a legal or constructive obligation with no realistic alternative to settlement.

examples.en: In the example, the obligating event was installing equipment that the company had committed to remove later.
examples.zh: 例题中的「义务形成事项」是安装设备，因为公司已经承诺之后会将设备拆除。

examples.en: The tutor asked which obligating event had occurred before the closing date in the accounting case.
examples.zh: 老师问，会计例题中什么「义务形成事项」已在结账日前发生。

collocations: the date of the obligating event

words.zhGloss: 由法律或合同产生的义务
words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, an obligation arising from a contract, legislation, or another operation of law.
acceptedZhAnswers: 由法律或合同产生的义务

examples.en: The case described a legal obligation to restore the leased site under the terms of its contract.
examples.zh: 例题说明，按租赁合同条款，恢复租赁场地属于一项「由法律或合同产生的义务」。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished a legal obligation from a promise created by a company's established business practices.
examples.zh: 老师区分了「由法律或合同产生的义务」和根据公司一贯经营做法形成的承诺。

collocations: a legal obligation under a contract

words.enDefinition: An obligation created when an entity's actions lead others reasonably to expect that it will accept specific responsibilities.

examples.en: The group's longstanding refund practice created a constructive obligation in the example even without a contractual requirement.
examples.zh: 例题中，尽管合同未作要求，集团长期沿用的退款做法仍形成了「推定义务」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the specific public promise gave customers enough reason to expect a constructive obligation.
examples.zh: 老师问，这项明确的公开承诺是否足以让顾客预期公司会承担「推定义务」。

collocations: assess whether a constructive obligation exists
a constructive obligation arising from past practice

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, to record a present obligation when an outflow is probable and a reliable estimate is possible.

examples.en: The class decided to recognise a provision after estimating the probable costs of restoring the leased site.
examples.zh: 同学们估算了很可能发生的租用场地恢复成本后，决定「确认预计负债」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what evidence the company needed before it could recognise a provision for the repair claims.
examples.zh: 老师问，公司需要哪些证据，才能就维修索赔「确认预计负债」。

collocations: recognise a provision at year end
assess whether to recognise a provision

words.zhGloss: 很可能发生的资源流出
words.enDefinition: In IAS 37, a transfer of resources that is more likely to occur than not as an obligation is settled.
acceptedZhAnswers: 很可能发生的资源流出

examples.en: The case described a probable outflow of resources after the company assessed outstanding claims from the warranty programme.
examples.zh: 公司评估保修计划中尚未处理的索赔后，例题描述了「很可能发生的资源流出」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what evidence supported a probable outflow of resources in the sample financial statements.
examples.zh: 老师问，哪些证据支持示例财务报表所称「很可能发生的资源流出」。

collocations: assess a probable outflow of resources
evidence of a probable outflow of resources
identify a probable outflow of resources

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, the amount that best reflects what settling or transferring the obligation would cost at the reporting date.

examples.en: The warranty example used recent claims experience to develop the best estimate of costs for products already sold.
examples.zh: 保修例题依据近期索赔情况，得出已售产品预计赔付成本的「最佳估计数」。

examples.en: We compared the best estimate with the amounts in the sample note to understand how uncertainty was reported.
examples.zh: 我们用「最佳估计数」对照示例附注里的金额，了解报告如何说明不确定性。

collocations: review the best estimate for a provision
use the best estimate of settlement costs

words.enDefinition: A provision measured at the present value of the expected expenditure required to settle it.

examples.en: The example showed a discounted provision because restoration payments were expected several years after the reporting date.
examples.zh: 例题预计场地恢复费用在报告期末几年后支付，因此列示了「折现后的预计负债」。

examples.en: We located the discounted provision in the notes before checking the assumptions behind the future cost estimate.
examples.zh: 核对未来成本估计所依据的假设前，我们先在附注中找到了「折现后的预计负债」。

collocations: a discounted provision for site restoration

words.enDefinition: The increase in the present value of a discounted balance due solely to the passage of time.
acceptedZhAnswers: 时间推移引起的折现摊回

examples.en: The provision increased through unwinding of the discount as another year passed before the scheduled restoration.
examples.zh: 距离预定恢复场地的日期又近了一年，预计负债因「折现摊回」而增加。

examples.en: The note showed unwinding of the discount separately from a change to expected restoration costs.
examples.zh: 附注把「折现摊回」和预计恢复成本的变动分开列示。

collocations: recognise the unwinding of the discount
a charge from unwinding of the discount
the effect of unwinding of the discount

words.enDefinition: Expenditure incurred and charged against a previously recorded provision for the same obligation.

examples.en: The provision utilisation line showed the repair costs charged against the opening balance during the period.
examples.zh: 「预计负债使用额」一行列出了本期冲减期初余额的维修费用。

examples.en: Our group compared provision utilisation with the costs estimated when the defective products were originally sold.
examples.zh: 我们组把「预计负债使用额」与有缺陷的商品原先售出时估计的成本作比较。

collocations: show provision utilisation in a reconciliation

words.enDefinition: Removal of all or part of a provision when the amount is no longer needed.

examples.en: The worksheet showed a provision reversal after evidence indicated that some of the expected claims would not arise.
examples.zh: 证据显示一些原先预计的索赔不会发生后，练习表列出了一项「预计负债转回」。

examples.en: Our tutor separated a provision reversal from using the balance to cover repairs the company had paid for.
examples.zh: 老师把「预计负债转回」同以余额冲抵公司已支付的维修费用区分开。

collocations: show a provision reversal in the notes

words.enDefinition: A reconciliation showing changes from the opening to the closing balances of a class of provisions.

examples.en: The provision rollforward showed new warranty costs, amounts used and the balance at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 「预计负债余额变动表」列明了保修预计负债的新增金额、使用额和年末余额。

examples.en: We used the provision rollforward to identify why the closing liability was higher despite fewer repair claims.
examples.zh: 我们用「预计负债余额变动表」查明为什么维修索赔减少了，期末负债却增加了。

collocations: list amounts used in a provision rollforward

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, a possible asset from past events whose existence depends on uncertain events outside full entity control.

examples.en: The exercise classified the possible compensation as a contingent asset while the claim's outcome remained uncertain.
examples.zh: 索赔结果尚未确定时，练习将可能获得的赔偿归为「或有资产」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what would happen to the contingent asset if the receipt became virtually certain.
examples.zh: 老师问，如果收到款项基本确定，这项「或有资产」会怎样处理。

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, a possible obligation or a present obligation not recognised because outflow is not probable or measurement unreliable.

examples.en: The note described a contingent liability because it was unclear whether the company would have to pay.
examples.zh: 由于公司是否必须付款尚不清楚，附注说明了一项「或有负债」。

examples.en: The class distinguished a contingent liability in the notes from a provision on the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 同学们区分了附注中的「或有负债」和资产负债表中的预计负债。

collocations: describe the nature of a contingent liability

words.enDefinition: An obligation from a past event whose existence depends on one or more uncertain future events.

examples.en: The pending decision left a possible obligation because the company disputed whether it was responsible for the damage.
examples.zh: 由于公司对责任认定持异议，未作出的裁决意味着仍存在「潜在义务」。

examples.en: Our group discussed whether the possible obligation would become clearer when the independent review was complete.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论了，独立调查结束后，这项「潜在义务」会不会更明朗。

collocations: evaluate whether a possible obligation exists
disclose the nature of a possible obligation

words.enDefinition: In contingency reporting, a very low likelihood that settling a matter will require a transfer of economic resources.

examples.en: The tutor asked what evidence supported a remote possibility of outflow for the disputed expense in the case.
examples.zh: 老师问，哪些证据支持这样的判断：例题中的争议费用引起「资源流出可能性极小」。

examples.en: The notes exercise treated a remote possibility of outflow differently from a payment considered more likely.
examples.zh: 附注练习对「资源流出可能性极小」和更可能发生付款的情况作了不同处理。

collocations: assess a remote possibility of outflow
a remote possibility of outflow of resources
conclude there is a remote possibility of outflow

words.enDefinition: An inflow of economic benefits whose receipt is sufficiently certain that the asset is no longer contingent under IAS 37.

examples.en: The accounting exercise treated the confirmed settlement as a virtually certain inflow when discussing the related asset.
examples.zh: 练习讨论相关资产时，把已确认的和解款视为「基本确定的资源流入」。

examples.en: Our group asked which new evidence would support a virtually certain inflow in the unfinished claim scenario.
examples.zh: 我们组问，索赔尚未了结时，哪些新证据能支持「基本确定的资源流入」的判断。

collocations: evidence of a virtually certain inflow
account for a virtually certain inflow

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, a separately recognised right to recover expenditure when reimbursement is virtually certain if the obligation is settled.

examples.en: The exercise showed the reimbursement asset separately because an insurer would cover part of the settlement.
examples.zh: 练习把「补偿资产」单独列出，因为保险方会承担部分和解款。

examples.en: We compared the recognised reimbursement asset with the expense the example company expected to recover.
examples.zh: 我们对比了已确认的「补偿资产」和示例公司预期可以收回的费用。

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, a contract whose unavoidable costs exceed the expected economic benefits from it.

examples.en: The worksheet showed an onerous contract because the unavoidable costs exceeded the benefits expected from the order.
examples.zh: 未能避免的成本超过这笔订单的预期经济利益，练习表因此列出一项「亏损合同」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the arrangement became an onerous contract after the supplier increased material prices.
examples.zh: 老师问，供应商提高材料价格之后，这项安排为什么成了「亏损合同」。

collocations: recognise a provision for an onerous contract
assess whether a contract is an onerous contract

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37 for an onerous contract, the lower of fulfilment costs and compensation or penalties for failing to fulfil it.

examples.en: We compared the cost of delivery with the amount payable for cancellation to find the unavoidable costs.
examples.zh: 我们对照交付成本和取消合同时应付的金额，以求出「不可避免的成本」。

examples.en: The exercise asked whether the contract's benefits would still cover the unavoidable costs after materials became more expensive.
examples.zh: 练习问，材料涨价后，合同经济利益是否仍能覆盖「不可避免的成本」。

collocations: determine unavoidable costs under the contract

words.enDefinition: A provision for dismantling an asset, removing it, or restoring a site when an applicable obligation exists.

examples.en: The case recorded a decommissioning provision for removing the installation and restoring the site later.
examples.zh: 例题确认了一项「弃置义务预计负债」，对应之后拆除装置并恢复场地所需费用。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how extending the equipment's useful life would affect the existing decommissioning provision.
examples.zh: 老师问，延长设备的使用寿命会怎样影响现有的「弃置义务预计负债」。

words.enDefinition: a provision for expected costs of a warranty that assures already sold goods meet agreed specifications, separate from revenue accounting for an additional warranty service

examples.en: The case updated the warranty provision after a new set of repair claims arrived from customers.
examples.zh: 收到顾客新提交的一批维修索赔后，例题更新了「产品保修预计负债」。

examples.en: We checked whether the warranty provision covered products the sample company had sold before year end.
examples.zh: 我们核对「产品保修预计负债」是否涵盖示例公司年末前已经售出的商品。

collocations: increase the warranty provision for expected claims

words.enDefinition: An IAS 37 provision for qualifying direct restructuring expenditure when a present obligation to restructure exists.

examples.en: The tutor asked which direct costs belonged in the restructuring provision after reading the published plan.
examples.zh: 阅读已公布的方案后，老师问，哪些直接支出应计入「重组预计负债」。

examples.en: Our example treated announcement of the detailed closure plan as evidence in assessing a restructuring provision.
examples.zh: 例题把宣布详细关停计划作为评估「重组预计负债」的一项证据。

collocations: disclose the basis of a restructuring provision

words.enDefinition: The period or dates when an entity expects payments or other transfers arising from a liability to occur.

examples.en: The provisions note gave the expected timing of outflows for repairs planned over the next two years.
examples.zh: 预计负债附注列出了未来两年维修支出的「预计资源流出时间」。

examples.en: Our tutor looked at the expected timing of outflows before comparing two estimates of the same obligation.
examples.zh: 老师先查看「预计资源流出时间」，再对比同一义务的两项估计。

collocations: disclose the expected timing of outflows
explain the expected timing of outflows
describe uncertainty around the expected timing of outflows

words.enDefinition: Under IFRS 15, a promise to transfer a distinct good or service, bundle, or qualifying series to a customer.

examples.en: The sample contract contained a performance obligation to provide twelve months of access to the online service.
examples.zh: 示例合同中有一项「履约义务」，是提供十二个月的在线服务使用权限。

examples.en: Our tutor asked when the company satisfied the performance obligation for the equipment it had promised to deliver.
examples.zh: 老师问，公司什么时候履行了交付承诺设备的「履约义务」。

collocations: allocate the transaction price to a performance obligation

words.zhGloss: 可明确区分的商品或服务
words.enDefinition: Under IFRS 15, an item the customer can benefit from and whose promised transfer is separately identifiable within the contract.
acceptedZhAnswers: 可明确区分的商品或服务

examples.en: The case treated training as a distinct good or service because it could be used and delivered separately.
examples.zh: 培训可以单独使用，也可单独交付，所以例题把它视为「可明确区分的商品或服务」。

examples.en: We checked whether installation qualified as a distinct good or service within the equipment contract.
examples.zh: 我们核对设备合同中的安装是否属于「可明确区分的商品或服务」。

collocations: identify a distinct good or service
transfer a distinct good or service
assess whether an item is a distinct good or service

words.enDefinition: Under IFRS 15, the consideration an entity expects for promised transfers, excluding amounts collected for third parties.

examples.en: The case estimated the transaction price after taking expected refunds into account for the goods sold.
examples.zh: 例题在估计「交易价格」时，考虑了已售货物可能要退还的款项。

examples.en: We allocated the transaction price between the equipment and the additional support promised in the contract.
examples.zh: 我们把「交易价格」分配给设备和合同承诺的额外支持服务。

words.enDefinition: The price an entity would charge for selling a promised good or service separately to a customer.

examples.en: We estimated the stand-alone selling price of the training because it was usually sold with equipment.
examples.zh: 培训通常与设备一同出售，因此我们估算了培训的「单独售价」。

examples.en: The worksheet compared each stand-alone selling price before allocating the contract price between two performance obligations.
examples.zh: 练习表先对比各项「单独售价」，再将合同价格分摊给两项履约义务。

collocations: allocate revenue using the stand-alone selling price

words.enDefinition: Consideration under a contract that may change because of refunds, bonuses, discounts or other uncertain factors.

examples.en: The tutor pointed out variable consideration because the service fee included a bonus for early completion.
examples.zh: 由于服务费含提前完工奖金，老师指出其中有「可变对价」。

examples.en: The example updated variable consideration after more customers claimed the rebate than the company had originally expected.
examples.zh: 申请返利的顾客多于公司起初预期，因此例题更新了「可变对价」。

collocations: constrain an estimate of variable consideration
update variable consideration at period end

words.enDefinition: A conditional right to consideration for goods or services already transferred, with a condition beyond the passage of time.

examples.en: The case recorded a contract asset because payment for completed work depended on delivering the final component.
examples.zh: 已完成工作的付款还取决于最后一个部件的交付，因此例题确认了「合同资产」。

examples.en: We explained why the contract asset became a receivable only after the remaining delivery condition was satisfied.
examples.zh: 我们解释了为什么只有满足剩下的交付条件后，「合同资产」才转为应收款。

collocations: reclassify a contract asset as a receivable
disclose the opening contract asset balance

words.enDefinition: An obligation to transfer goods or services for consideration received or due from the customer.

examples.en: The company recorded a contract liability when it took advance payment for a course starting in June.
examples.zh: 公司收取六月开课的课程预付款时确认了「合同负债」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which service would have to be delivered before the contract liability could decrease.
examples.zh: 老师问，交付哪项服务后「合同负债」才能减少。

collocations: recognise revenue from a contract liability

words.enDefinition: A material financing benefit provided to either party by the timing of payments relative to promised transfers under IFRS 15.

examples.en: The class checked for a significant financing component because the payment date was much later than delivery.
examples.zh: 付款日远晚于交付日，因此全班核查有无「重大融资成分」。

examples.en: Our worksheet separated interest from the sale price after identifying a significant financing component in the contract.
examples.zh: 确定合同含有「重大融资成分」后，练习表把利息与销售价格分开列示。

collocations: account for a significant financing component

words.zhGloss: 在一段时间内确认收入
words.enDefinition: Recognising revenue as the entity satisfies a performance obligation over a period rather than on a single date.
acceptedZhAnswers: 在一段时间内确认收入

examples.en: The case used over-time revenue recognition for support that customers received throughout the six-month service agreement.
examples.zh: 顾客在六个月的服务协议期内持续获得支持，例题因此采用「在一段时间内确认收入」。

examples.en: We checked the reported measure of progress before interpreting over-time revenue recognition in the sample notes.
examples.zh: 我们先查看列报的履约进度计量方法，再解读示例附注如何「在一段时间内确认收入」。

collocations: assess eligibility for over-time revenue recognition
explain the method for over-time revenue recognition

words.enDefinition: Recognising revenue when the customer obtains control and the performance obligation is satisfied at a single point.

examples.en: The exercise applied point-in-time revenue recognition when the customer took control of the equipment at delivery.
examples.zh: 顾客在交付时取得设备控制权，例题选择「在某一时点确认收入」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared point-in-time revenue recognition for the equipment with the pattern for the ongoing support service.
examples.zh: 老师对比了设备「在某一时点确认收入」的做法和持续支持服务的确认方式。

collocations: an example of point-in-time revenue recognition
explain point-in-time revenue recognition at delivery

words.enDefinition: Under IFRS 15, a measure of how much of an over-time performance obligation has been satisfied.

examples.en: The notes explained why hours of support delivered provided a reasonable measure of progress in the example.
examples.zh: 附注解释了为什么例题中已提供支持服务的工时是合理的「履约进度计量指标」。

examples.en: Our group used the measure of progress to calculate the revenue earned by the end of June.
examples.zh: 我们组用「履约进度计量指标」计算截至六月底已赚取的收入。

collocations: apply a measure of progress consistently

words.enDefinition: Contractual promises the entity has yet to satisfy, including any unsatisfied portions of partly fulfilled promises.

examples.en: The notes identified the remaining performance obligations for service to be delivered after the end of the year.
examples.zh: 附注列出了年末之后还需交付的服务所对应的「剩余履约义务」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how much of the contract price was allocated to remaining performance obligations in the example.
examples.zh: 老师问，例题中合同价格有多少分配给了「剩余履约义务」。

collocations: allocate consideration to remaining performance obligations
describe the timing of remaining performance obligations

words.enDefinition: breaking reported revenue into categories that show how economic factors affect the nature, amount, timing or uncertainty of revenue and cash flows

examples.en: The notes provided revenue disaggregation by product line so readers could see which sales categories were growing.
examples.zh: 附注按产品线进行「收入分拆披露」，让读者看到哪些销售类别在增长。

examples.en: Our group compared revenue disaggregation by location with a table split by the timing of delivery.
examples.zh: 我们组把按地点做的「收入分拆披露」和按交付时点划分的表格作了比较。

collocations: discuss the basis for revenue disaggregation

words.enDefinition: In IFRS 15 disclosure, balances of receivables, contract assets and contract liabilities arising from customer contracts.

examples.en: The note compared contract balances at the beginning and end of the year for the service contracts.
examples.zh: 附注比较了服务合同的年初和年末「合同相关余额」。

examples.en: Our class checked the contract balances before explaining why the company had received more cash than reported revenue.
examples.zh: 在解释公司收到的现金为何超过列报收入前，同学们先核对了「合同相关余额」。

collocations: reconcile opening and closing contract balances

words.enDefinition: A person or entity with a relationship to the reporting entity that qualifies under the applicable reporting rules.

examples.en: The reporting exercise identified the parent company as a related party before reviewing any outstanding balances.
examples.zh: 报表练习先把母公司确定为「关联方」，再核查未结余额。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what information showed that the supplier qualified as a related party under IAS 24.
examples.zh: 老师问，有什么信息表明供应商在 IAS 24 下属于「关联方」。

collocations: determine whether an entity is a related party
a transaction with a related party

words.enDefinition: A transfer of resources, services or obligations between related parties, whether or not any amount is charged.

examples.en: The class identified a related party transaction when the parent supplied office space to its subsidiary without charge.
examples.zh: 母公司免费向子公司提供办公场地，同学们将其识别为一项「关联方交易」。

examples.en: The notes explained the purpose of the related party transaction and how it affected expenses for the year.
examples.zh: 附注解释了「关联方交易」的目的和它对当年费用的影响。

words.enDefinition: An amount still due to or from a related party at a specified date.

examples.en: The sample report disclosed a related party balance after the subsidiary bought equipment from its parent on credit.
examples.zh: 子公司向母公司赊购设备后，示例报告披露了一笔「关联方往来余额」。

examples.en: We traced the related party balance in the note to the year-end receivable in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把附注里的「关联方往来余额」追溯到练习表上的年末应收款。

collocations: explain the terms of a related party balance

words.enDefinition: Commitments to transfer resources or provide services under arrangements involving a related party.

examples.en: The note on related party commitments described an agreement to buy services from an entity under common control.
examples.zh: 「关联方承诺事项」附注说明了从一家同受控制的主体购买服务的协议。

examples.en: Our group listed related party commitments separately from invoices already included in the example's reported balances.
examples.zh: 我们组单独列出「关联方承诺事项」，与已计入例题所列余额的发票分开。

collocations: describe the terms of related party commitments

words.enDefinition: People with authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling an entity's activities, directly or indirectly.

examples.en: The class identified key management personnel based on who actually directed the group's activities in the case.
examples.zh: 同学们依据例题中谁实际领导集团经营活动来识别「关键管理人员」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the note on key management personnel included directors from outside the executive team.
examples.zh: 老师问，「关键管理人员」附注为什么纳入了行政团队以外的董事。

collocations: disclose remuneration of key management personnel

words.enDefinition: Benefits provided in exchange for the services of people who direct and control the entity's activities.

examples.en: The sample note broke down key management compensation into salary, pension benefits and share-based payments.
examples.zh: 示例附注把「关键管理人员薪酬」分成工资、养老金福利和股份支付。

examples.en: Our group compared the categories in the key management compensation note with those in the prior-year report.
examples.zh: 我们组把「关键管理人员薪酬」附注的类别与上年报告中的类别作了对比。

collocations: review the note on key management compensation

words.enDefinition: In IAS 24, family members expected to influence, or be influenced by, someone in dealings with the entity.
acceptedEnVariants: close members of a person's family

examples.en: The class considered close members of the family when discussing the director's connection to the supplier.
examples.zh: 讨论董事与供应商的联系时，全班考虑了「关系密切的家庭成员」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how influence could matter when identifying close members of the family under IAS 24.
examples.zh: 老师说明在 IAS 24 下识别「关系密切的家庭成员」时，影响力为什么重要。

collocations: identify close members of the family
consider close members of the family
transactions involving close members of the family

words.enDefinition: The party at the top of the ownership or control chain that ultimately controls the reporting entity.

examples.en: The notes identified the ultimate controlling party separately from the company's immediate parent in the group structure.
examples.zh: 附注将「最终控制方」与集团结构中公司的直接母公司分开列出。

examples.en: We followed the chain of control to identify the ultimate controlling party in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们沿控制关系逐层追溯，找出了课堂例题中的「最终控制方」。

collocations: name the ultimate controlling party in the notes

words.enDefinition: Terms comparable to those that independent parties would agree to under similar circumstances.

examples.en: The class compared the sister company's rental agreement with independent leases when discussing arm's length terms.
examples.zh: 全班讨论「公平交易条款」时，把同一集团内公司的租赁协议与独立各方之间的租约作了比较。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what evidence would support the claim that the loan was made on arm's length terms.
examples.zh: 老师问，什么证据可以支持该贷款是按「公平交易条款」发放的说法。

words.enDefinition: Information accompanying the primary statements that explains reported amounts, accounting policies and other relevant matters.

examples.en: We read the notes to the financial statements to find out what caused the increase in provisions.
examples.zh: 我们读了「财务报表附注」，了解预计负债增加的原因。

examples.en: The notes to the financial statements explained which expenses were included in each category in the table.
examples.zh: 「财务报表附注」解释了表格里每一类包含哪些费用。

collocations: read the notes to the financial statements
include information in the notes to the financial statements
refer to the notes to the financial statements

words.enDefinition: A number or label beside a reported item directing readers to its related financial statement note.

examples.en: I followed the note reference beside the property balance to find a breakdown of the total.
examples.zh: 我顺着物业余额旁的「附注编号」找到了总额明细。

examples.en: The note reference next to the provision line matched the number at the top of the supporting table.
examples.zh: 预计负债项目旁的「附注编号」和明细表顶部的编号一致。

collocations: insert a note reference next to a line item

words.enDefinition: A list used to check that the disclosures relevant to a set of accounts have been considered.

examples.en: We used a disclosure checklist to see whether the sample statements addressed all the relevant note topics.
examples.zh: 我们对照「披露核对清单」，看示例财务报表是否涵盖附注里所有相关主题。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to annotate the disclosure checklist when a requirement did not apply to the example.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们在「披露核对清单」上注明哪些要求不适用于例题。

collocations: review the disclosure checklist for applicable items

words.enDefinition: The purpose of a disclosure, expressed in terms of what it should help financial statement users understand.

examples.en: The class read the disclosure objective before choosing what to explain about the timing of contract revenue.
examples.zh: 全班先读了「披露目标」，再决定怎样说明合同收入的确认时间。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the table met the disclosure objective for uncertainty around the reported valuation.
examples.zh: 老师问，这张表是否实现了说明列报金额估值不确定性的「披露目标」。

collocations: explain how a note addresses the disclosure objective

words.enDefinition: A requirement specifying information to be provided in financial statements or accompanying notes under an applicable rule.

examples.en: We identified the disclosure requirement that applied to the company's remaining obligations in the example contract.
examples.zh: 我们找到了适用于例题公司剩余合同义务的「披露要求」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to write a note that addressed each disclosure requirement in the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师让我们写一则附注，涵盖练习中的各项「披露要求」。

collocations: check whether a disclosure requirement applies

words.enDefinition: The reporting framework and conventions used to prepare a set of financial statements.

examples.en: We checked the basis of preparation before comparing the example statements with a company reporting under different standards.
examples.zh: 在把示例财务报表与采用不同准则的公司作比较前，我们先核对了「财务报表编制基础」。

examples.en: The basis of preparation explained which reporting framework the group used for its consolidated statements.
examples.zh: 「财务报表编制基础」说明了集团用哪套报告框架来编制合并报表。

words.enDefinition: a formal declaration of compliance with the identified accounting standards, explicit and unreserved where the applicable framework requires

examples.en: The notes included a statement of compliance identifying the reporting standards used for the example accounts.
examples.zh: 附注包含一份「准则遵循声明」，指出示例报表遵循哪些财务报告准则。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the IFRS statement of compliance appeared in the sample annual report.
examples.zh: 老师问，示例年报里的哪份「准则遵循声明」表明财务报表按国际财务报告准则编制。

collocations: an unreserved statement of compliance with IFRS

words.enDefinition: Combining items with shared characteristics into a single total or group in financial reporting.

examples.en: The report used aggregation for several small costs that shared the same nature in the example.
examples.zh: 示例报告对几项性质相同的小额费用作了「汇总列报」。

examples.en: Our group discussed whether further aggregation would make the main statement easier to read in this case.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论了在本例中进一步「汇总列报」会不会让主表更易读。

words.enDefinition: Separating a group of reported items into components when their characteristics or effects differ in relevant ways.

examples.en: The exercise used disaggregation to show which operating costs changed when the company added the new service.
examples.zh: 练习以「分拆列报」展示公司新增服务后哪些运营成本发生了变化。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the notes provided enough disaggregation to explain the unusually large expense item.
examples.zh: 老师问，附注里的「分拆列报」是否足以说明金额异常大的费用项目。

words.enDefinition: Assessing whether omitting, misstating or obscuring information could reasonably be expected to influence primary users' decisions.

examples.en: The class made a materiality judgement before deciding which supplier dispute needed a separate explanation in the note.
examples.zh: 全班先作出「重要性判断」，再确定哪笔供应商争议需要在附注单独说明。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the nature of an item mattered when making a materiality judgement in the example.
examples.zh: 老师解释了在例题中作「重要性判断」时，为什么项目本身的性质很重要。

collocations: apply a materiality judgement to a disclosure

words.enDefinition: Presenting material information so unclearly that its effect is similar to omitting or misstating it.

examples.en: The class removed unrelated details from the note to avoid obscuring material information about the large provision.
examples.zh: 为了避免「使重要信息难以辨识」，全班删去了大额预计负债附注中无关的细节。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed obscuring material information when key explanations appeared in several unrelated parts of the report.
examples.zh: 关键说明散在报告几个无关位置，老师因此讨论了「使重要信息难以辨识」的问题。

collocations: identify wording that is obscuring material information

words.enDefinition: Presenting assets against liabilities or income against expenses as a single net amount under applicable rules.

examples.en: The class discussed offsetting after noticing that the example statement showed one net amount for two balances.
examples.zh: 发现示例报表用一个净额列示两个余额后，全班讨论了「抵销列报」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which conditions would permit offsetting the two financial instruments in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 老师问，课堂例题中哪些条件允许对这两项金融工具作「抵销列报」。

words.enDefinition: The primary statement pages where line items and totals are presented, as distinct from the supporting notes.

examples.en: The total appeared on the face of the financial statements, with a detailed breakdown in the notes.
examples.zh: 总额列在「财务报表主表」，明细则列在附注里。

examples.en: We checked whether the figure was on the face of the financial statements before looking through the notes.
examples.zh: 翻查附注之前，我们先看「财务报表主表」有没有该金额。

collocations: present separately on the face of the financial statements
appear on the face of the financial statements
a line on the face of the financial statements

words.enDefinition: How individual items are shown on separate lines in a financial statement.

examples.en: The tutor reviewed line item presentation after the sample statement added a separate line for financing expenses.
examples.zh: 示例报表新增一行单独列示融资费用后，老师核查了「报表项目列示」。

examples.en: Our group changed the line item presentation so the major expense categories were easier to find.
examples.zh: 我们组调整了「报表项目列示」，让主要费用类别更容易找到。

words.enDefinition: Providing separate note information for groups of items sharing common features, such as types of provisions.

examples.en: The exercise used disclosure by class to separate restoration provisions from the balance for warranty obligations.
examples.zh: 练习用「按类别披露」把场地恢复预计负债和保修义务余额分别列示。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the disclosure by class after the sample company combined two similar groups of provisions.
examples.zh: 示例公司合并两组相似的预计负债后，老师核查了「按类别披露」的结果。

collocations: organise a table for disclosure by class
review disclosure by class of provision

words.enDefinition: A written explanation in financial reporting that describes facts, judgements or uncertainties in words.

examples.en: The narrative disclosure explained why the two valuation methods produced different results for the same property.
examples.zh: 「文字说明式披露」解释了为什么两种估值方法对同一物业得出不同的结果。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to add narrative disclosure about the timetable below the table of expected payments.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在预计付款表下补充关于时间安排的「文字说明式披露」。

collocations: accompany a table with narrative disclosure
